title: More on expressibility of satisfiability in submodels and extensions
summary: We study expressibility in infinitary languages of the modal operators associated with satisfiability of sentences of these languages in submodels and extensions of models. We give a syntactic criterion for expressibility in finitary predicate languages, show that in many cases infinitary languages are closed under the operator associated with submodels, and that this is so in any language with a purely monadic signature.
